text:
max: quick onboarding hiccup in sample-app: JS SDK helper accepting extra fields when jsonMode=true and additionalProperties=true in schema. Python rejects the extras.

max: minimal repro:
```js
await client.generate({
  model: 'rwd-chat-1.0',
  jsonMode: true,
  function_call: { name: 'register_user', arguments_schema: {
    type: 'object',
    properties: { name: { type: 'string' }, email: { type: 'string' } },
    required: ['name','email'],
    additionalProperties: true // scaffold default
  }},
  input: prompt
})
// model returns { name: 'A', email: 'a@x', org_id: 123 }
// JS helper accepts org_id (number) and passes through; Py strips/rejects depending on schema handling
```

erin: ooof. scaffolds set additionalProperties:true to be permissive for demos but that can hide typing/parity bugs. Did we see downstream failures?

max: yes, downstream DB expects org_id as string, so numeric org_id caused silent conversion later and a migration error. Also the auth-retry path can double-stringify in some JS flows which then turns objects into strings if serializers run in the wrong order.

sasha: which SDK versions? I want to check retry + parse ordering differences.

max: js@2.5.0, py@1.12.0, samplekit v0.30. Trace: helper.parse() -> validate() -> return object -> retry serialize on auth-refresh -> double-encoded sometimes. Python keeps object.

kevin: immediate fixes: 1) change samplekit defaults to additionalProperties:false for function_call schemas in scaffolds; 2) add a lint that warns when additionalProperties:true is present in fncall schemas; 3) ensure JS helper runs parse/validate before any retry serialization and does not coerce types after validation.

erin: i can patch samplekit scaffolds and add a migration note: "scaffolded fncall schemas are now strict by default; set permissive mode explicitly only for demos."

sasha: i'll add a small unit that simulates auth-refresh 401 and ensures helperResult remains a plain object (typeof === 'object') after retries. Also add integration that verifies extra fields cause validation errors when additionalProperties:false.

ci-bot: CI: samplekit unit matrix failed in run 8342 on node14, linking logs https://ci.internal/8342 (auto-report).

kevin: for the JS SDK change, plan is: parseBeforeRetry true, strictSchemaByDefault for fncall helpers, and a new helper option `preserveTypesOnRetry: true`. Will open PRs.

max: thanks. labeling thread devex:fncall-schema and moving to triage. I'll re-run the onboarding flow after PRs land.

erin: also adding a one-liner to the quickstart: "Avoid additionalProperties:true for production fncall schemas; it may mask type/parity issues between SDKs."
